name: Hauppauge Shopping Center
summary: Hauppauge Shopping Center is a community retail destination on Long Island's Smithtown Bypass, owned by Federal Realty Investment Trust. With a 4.3-star rating and over 833 reviews, it serves as a convenient shopping hub for Suffolk County residents.
demographics: Hauppauge Shopping Center serves a predominantly suburban Long Island demographic with middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area attracts families and professionals from Suffolk County communities, with visitors typically ranging from 30-65 years old with household incomes above the national median. The center draws shoppers seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services, with a customer base that values quality national retailers and accessible shopping experiences in a suburban setting.
description: Hauppauge Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination located at 371 Smithtown Bypass in Hauppauge, New York, serving the heart of Long Island's Suffolk County. Owned and operated by Federal Realty Investment Trust, a premier real estate investment trust with a distinguished portfolio of high-quality retail properties across the United States, this center has become a cornerstone of the local retail landscape. The shopping center offers convenient access to a diverse mix of national retailers and service providers, making it a go-to destination for everyday shopping needs and specialty purchases. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, the center provides flexibility for busy shoppers throughout the week. The property has earned strong community recognition, reflected in its impressive 4.3-star rating from over 833 Google reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its valued role in the Hauppauge community.
